mapper.select: select c.id, c.author_user_id, c.title, coalesce(c.publish_time, 0) as publish_time, c.status, c.visibility, u.fanout_mode, coalesce(stats.follower_count, 0) as follower_count from content_items c join users u on u.id = c.author_user_id left join user_social_stats stats on stats.user_id = u.id where c.id = #{contentId}
